rules.title: Hoboken Rent Leveling – annual rent increase cap (Section 155-5)
rules.requirement: Under Hoboken's rent leveling ordinance, as amended February 1, 2023, a landlord may not request or receive a rent increase greater than 5%. The city publishes a regional CPI table for calculating allowable increases.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to Hoboken Rent Leveling (Hoboken Code Chapter 155). This document does not state coverage details.
rules.quoted_span:
No landlord may request or 
receive a percentage increase in 
rent which is greater than 5%
rules.conflict_note: Source is a city CPI table with a brief note. It states only the 5% ceiling and the February 1, 2023 amendment date. The full CPI formula, coverage and exemptions (e.g., the NJ new-construction exemption) are not stated here. February 1, 2023 may be the adoption date rather than the effective date.
